description: Shares a Google Drive file or folder with one person by email address, as reader, commenter or writer. Takes the file ID, the address and the role, and optionally a message for the notification email. Google emails the person unless notify is false. Returns the file ID and its permission list afterwards: who has access, at what role. Sharing a file with someone already on it at another role adds no second entry; Drive keeps one per person. This gives the person access to the file and, for a folder, to what is inside it.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

email.description: The email address of the person to share with.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file or folder ID to share.

message.description: An optional message, sent in the notification email.

notify.description: Whether Google emails the person about the share (default: true).

role.description: The access to give: reader (view), commenter (view and comment) or writer (edit).

name: gws-mcp__drive_share_file
